deploy-bot: deploy triggered: release/2026-03-21-embed-alloc v2 -> prod (canary=10%) :rocket:
Nina: kicking off post-deploy verification now — canaries in us-central and eu-west. running synthetic embed probes and kv-prefill checks
canary-bot: synthetic embeddings (us-central) p95=118ms p50=32ms, kvcache_hit=0.92 :white_check_mark:
Hector: eu-west probe failing quickcheck: p95 jumped to 740ms and probe returned non-empty `prefill_mismatch` flag
Sofia: any 5xxs in frontends?
Hector: no 5xxs, but the probe payloads show prefills happening in different order. sample log: ```[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] probe[euw] prefill_seq=[meta,user,cache] expected=[user,meta,cache]```
Nina: that ordering could cause ineffective kvcache warmup leading to misses. was v2 supposed to change prefill ordering?
Sofia: v2 has async prefill to speed coldstart but should preserve ordering. looks like a race where `meta` is sometimes earlier due to threadpool scheduling differences on newer kernels
Hector: propose two actions: (1) put eu-west canary back to v1 routing (2) temporarily enlarge change window to avoid autopromote until we confirm warmup stability
Nina: +1. add (3) disable async-prefill flag for v2 in eu-west so we can test sync-prefill behavior without routing flip if possible
deploy-bot: routing override applied: eu-west -> embed-alloc-v1 (canary now v1) :white_check_mark:
canary-bot: eu-west synthetic after override p95=190ms kvcache_hit=0.86 (improved) :thumbsup:
Sofia: improvement but still above baseline 120ms. leave v1 pinned for 15m and collect traces. Nina, can you apply the flag change too?
Nina: flag set: `embed.alloc.v2.async_prefill=false` for routing group eu-west. will monitor
Hector: after flag change p95 dropped to 150ms and hit ratio back to 0.93. trending toward baseline
Sofia: good signal. next steps: (A) triage to root cause = prefill ordering/race on async path; collect thread dumps and scheduler metrics from v2 nodes during the spike window (B) plan hotfix: either reorder prefill to deterministic sequence or add per-request barrier before serving
Nina: will gather artifacts and create a short release-note blurb: "eu-west canary pinned to v1 after v2 exhibited prefill-order nondeterminism causing temporary p95 regression; mitigation applied and investigation ongoing."
Hector: assign owners: Nina = rollout coordination, Sofia = root-cause triage + kernel team loop, me (Hector) = synth probe enhancement (add prefill_seq assert).
Sofia: also recommending we add a post-deploy smoke that asserts `kvcache_hit_ratio >= 0.9` within 5m of rollout per-region. low-cost guardrail
Nina: added ticket to backlog and tagged it for the next patch cycle. for now we keep eu-west pinned and pause automated canary promotion in the change window.
deploy-bot: autopromote paused for embed-alloc-v2 in eu-west until 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z :information_source:
Hector: I'll push a small synth probe change to assert prefill order and run it in us-central v2 to ensure it doesn't regress there
Sofia: excellent. will follow up with postmortem draft once we have traces. thanks team — watching dashboards for 30m
Nina: thanks all. updates in ~20m. :white_check_mark:
